gloss_en: Long-time Revit user asks for a roadmap and first steps to build solid foundations in IFC and Bonsai, using a small timber house as a learning project
title_original: Roadmap for Revit migrator to Bonsai BIM - absolute beginner
question_paraphrase: Coming from Revit, where do I start with IFC and Bonsai? I am modelling a small timber house with several wall, slab, door, window and roof types and want proper foundations.
phrasing_notes: polite, thanks the community for free alternative to Revit, lists exact versions and types made, asks for roadmap
answer_summary: Follow the community Blender+Bonsai video tutorial series alongside your own project.

gloss_en: Revit veteran tests an AI (Claude via MCP) driven construction drawing process in Bonsai: PDF redlines revise the model, door/window schedules populate automatically; asks about lineweights, sections, tags, callouts, axon cutaways
title_original: Claude Bonsai Construction Drawings
question_paraphrase: Testing Claude with the Blender MCP and Bonsai to produce construction drawings from marked-up PDF redlines. Best practice: model in 3D or develop via 2D detailing? How to handle lineweights, object styles, coordinated sections, tags, callouts, exploded views? Anyone interpreting redlines with AI?
phrasing_notes: Shares a demo, apologises that design is only a test, long list of open workflow questions, asks for feedback
answer_summary: Only a clarifying question whether the IfcOpenShell MCP was used; the detailing and lineweight questions got no substantive answers.

gloss_en: Trainer shares a reproducible native-IFC project template (storeys, 39 materials, 234 types) for teaching and asks where native IFC modelling still breaks and whether drawing styles should be a national shared resource
title_original: Native IFC as the source: a reproducible project template for Bonsai, and two questions
question_paraphrase: Template repo with IFC4 template built by script; where does working purely in native IFC still break for you, and should national drawing styles (DIN) be shared outside the IFC?
phrasing_notes: structured post with numbered questions, hedges ('I may be wrong')
answer_summary: IFC does not store app state like layer/view visibility; styling rules belong in a sidecar outside the IFC while view/section definitions live inside.

gloss_en: German vocational teacher wants Bonsai drawings to follow DIN 1356-1 (line weights, hatches, dimensioning); asks where national conventions should live and how hatches and CSS classes work
title_original: German drawing conventions (DIN 1356-1) for Bonsai's 2D output
question_paraphrase: Using EPset_Drawing.Metadata set to material.Category adds CSS classes; clipped-line hatches print better than SVG pattern fills. Should conventions live in Bonsai defaults, a DIN template, or IfcFillAreaStyleHatching?
phrasing_notes: detailed technical report with selector names, print test numbers, shares scripts
answer_summary: Bonsai names classes like material-Name, cut, layer-material-category; .cut.IfcWall works while IfcWall.cut does not; hatches live in CSS, material-name vs category mapping debated.

gloss_en: User wants a production-ready open BIM app to move fully to Linux; finds Bonsai UI intimidating and not like architectural BIM; asks if others follow OpenAEC
title_original: OpenAEC moves away from Bonsai to homegrown BIM app?
question_paraphrase: OpenAEC removed Bonsai references from their site; are they building their own BIM app? I want something production ready for Linux; Bonsai can do it but UI and workflow feel intimidating.
answer_summary: Contributors say users can improve Bonsai themselves with AI coding; maintainers struggle with a flood of pull requests; suggestion to split Bonsai functions into tabs.

gloss_en: Cannot add a window to a wall in an existing file though a new project works; wonders if file is corrupt
title_original: Bonsai Windows
question_paraphrase: Adding a window to a wall fails: no add-window option in Wall Edit Tools and the Window tool does not attach to the wall. Is the IFC corrupted or a setting off?
phrasing_notes: short problem statement then guesses at cause
answer_summary: Snapping hit other objects instead of walls; isolate walls in local view; Shift+G / Refresh Geometry updates openings; other users report snap-target Faces and occlusion quirks.

gloss_en: Contributor builds load authoring and a solver link in Bonsai and asks what would make structural analysis useful; testers report load direction, missing load cases and file problems
title_original: Structural analysis in Bonsai: what I'm working on
question_paraphrase: Adding load authoring then analysis with open solver; results kept in results.json keyed to GlobalIds. What would make it useful in practice?
phrasing_notes: developer progress post, requests worked examples with known answers
answer_summary: Feedback on Eurocode checks, separating physical and analytical models, envelopes, color-coding by utilisation; bugs on Z-down axes and units found.

gloss_en: Developer proposes one parametric Framing system for railings, storefronts, curtain walls and fences and asks which systems people would model
title_original: Add parametric framing systems (railings, curtain walls, storefronts)
question_paraphrase: Single parametric system for repeating profiled members with panels; framed openings and corners; which systems would you model and what is missing?
answer_summary: Headers not yet types; each assembly is one Blender object for performance; layout engine separated from geometry could serve user-made parametric objects.

gloss_en: Bonsai daily builds fail to activate on Apple ARM Mac with ImportError for GMP, later a conflict with the Speckle add-on
title_original: Bonsai on Apple ARM, latest macOS ?
question_paraphrase: Bonsai dailies stopped loading on Blender 5.0/5.1 and 4.5 LTS: IfcOpenShell not built for darwin python3.11, missing GMP. Later failed to import query_to_pairs from yarl.
phrasing_notes: error text pasted, guesses at OS update as cause
answer_summary: Linked to an IfcOpenShell GitHub issue and fixed later; the yarl import error came from the Speckle add-on, disabling it let Bonsai activate.

gloss_en: Should structure, MEP and architecture be split into separate Bonsai files so people work in parallel, given voids appear in the architectural model
title_original: A Standard BIM workflow in Bonsai | Arch, Structure, MEP
question_paraphrase: If I split structure from architecture the architectural walls show voids. Is linking IFC the right way, can drawings combine elements from several files, or is a single file better?
phrasing_notes: workflow question, mentions concern about voids and quantities
answer_summary: Small teams keep one model; for distributed work use IfcMerge or links; share grid origin; use IfcCovering CLADDING; handle quantities with voids.

gloss_en: Browser tool generates editable IFC from a plain-language brief using MCP tools and IfcOpenShell; asks for feedback on IFC cleanliness
title_original: Text to IFC in the browser, built on IfcOpenShell. Looking for feedback
question_paraphrase: Describe a building in text and get real IFC entities, not a mesh; opens in Bonsai. Feedback on IFC cleanliness and features?
answer_summary: Testers liked it; suggested asking clarifying questions about stories, height, GFA, site; staged massing-first process; viewer explode bug fixed.

gloss_en: How to create clash sets and BCF projects together; clash check returns 0 clashes though one was made deliberately; wishes for multi-model checks and snapshots in BCF
title_original: Clash detection: How to?
question_paraphrase: In Quality Control I set filters, pick second file, run IFC Clash and get 0 clashes though I created one on purpose. Want to check several linked models, only transparent selected, button for open file, show results in panel, real snapshots in BCF.
phrasing_notes: step list with lettered wishes a-f
answer_summary: A SwigPyObject not-iterable error was already fixed in newer builds; the wishes got no replies.

gloss_en: Video tutorial series for AEC professionals; viewers ask where to start, how to organise materials and why the Outliner is flat
title_original: Video tutorial series for Blender + Bonsai
question_paraphrase: 122 short videos from a cube to a construction drawing set. Replies ask about order, payment, unlocking videos, one IfcMaterial per component, hiding IfcSpaces in a flat Outliner.
answer_summary: Follow the video index CSV; separate IfcMaterial per component lets annotations pull material names; flat hierarchy caused by keeping spatial structure in sync with collections.

gloss_en: Testing clash sets in Bonsai and getting errors every time on a daily build, cannot share file
title_original: Bonsai - Clash test bugs?
question_paraphrase: Clash set test gives errors, upgraded to latest daily build and get the same error each time; attached test file; others on Windows confirm.
phrasing_notes: short, screenshots, links forum post for more wishes
answer_summary: Other users confirm the same error on later builds.

gloss_en: Clash points reported do not match entry and exit points described in docs and vary with element pair order
title_original: Clarification on Clash Detection Points & Alternative Methods for Extracting Clash Geometry
question_paraphrase: I get two points per clash that depend on element order; they are not entry/exit corners of the protrusion nor bounding box corners of the clash volume. How to extract clash geometry?
phrasing_notes: academic careful tone, quotes docs, thanks maintainers
answer_summary: Another user reproduced the same point pairs; semantics of returned points unclear.

gloss_en: Homepage suggests ifcclash can be used without Python knowledge but the IfcConvert download has no ifcclash
title_original: how to use ifcclash on shell?
question_paraphrase: The Let's get started box implies ifcclash ships with IfcConvert, but it is only in IfcOpenShell Python; pip gives the library and not a command. Create an installer or fix the homepage.
answer_summary: IfcClash is separate, standalone in docs and bundled in the Bonsai add-on for a UI; pip gives only the library, contribution welcome.

gloss_en: Maintainer says IfcClash has never gone beyond showing touching things and plans to make it practically usable with clash types: protrusions, envelopes, piercings
title_original: Upgrades to IfcClash to be more fit for purpose
question_paraphrase: IfcClash barely progressed past it shows things which touch if you are lucky; I want correct results for protrusion, envelope, piercing clashes and clearance, and to fix packaging.
answer_summary: Work tracked with CI/OCCT version fixes in follow-up comments.

gloss_en: Clashing walls and slabs against a file of IfcSpaces sometimes returns result a and b flipped
title_original: incorrect results from clash_intersection_many
question_paraphrase: Result a should always be a wall or slab and b an IfcSpace but some results are swapped; mode intersection has the same issue; cannot share files.
phrasing_notes: code snippet attached, can't share files
answer_summary: Maintainer asks to extract a minimal anonymous subset as a unit test.

gloss_en: Clash location markers appear far away when the project units are feet because Bonsai assumes millimetres
title_original: IFC clash returns location in mm when ifc project in feet
question_paraphrase: Showing a clash in Bonsai with a feet project puts the annotation in the middle of nowhere instead of at the intersection.
phrasing_notes: calls it a corner case that should be an easy fix
answer_summary: Reporter later suspects false origin mode may be the real cause.

gloss_en: IDS property value checks on integer vs string give an odd 3 of 4 result matrix
title_original: ifctester ids simple value pset prop checks on integers and strings (bug?)
question_paraphrase: Model value as IfcInteger or IfcLabel with integer text checked against Python int or string gives mixed results; expected all pass, all fail or 2/2.
phrasing_notes: enumerated test cases, asks maintainer directly
answer_summary: Model data type leads and the IDS value is coerced; the one outlier is an artefact of passing a Python int through the API.

gloss_en: Rule checking that an IfcDoor has material Holz (wood) fails when the material is typed in, works only for materials already in the list
title_original: Probably Bug in Ifc Tester Webapp
question_paraphrase: I created a rule that a door has material Holz; the app wants ctrl+Enter to add the entry, then the rule fails. A material from the list passes. Maybe I am too stupid for it.
phrasing_notes: self-deprecating, vague title, German term, screenshot
answer_summary: Reply asks for concrete symptom, action, expected vs actual.

gloss_en: Wants multi-language support in IfcTester and its webapp to widen adoption
title_original: IfcTester : Multi-lang support
question_paraphrase: I would like to look into translating IfcTester and the webapp to widen adoption; where should it fit?
answer_summary: Use standard po files; split into facet string translation and static HTML reports.

gloss_en: Uppercase boolean FALSE in IDS is read as True so IsExternal=FALSE passes on an external wall
title_original: ifctester: IDS-valid uppercase boolean FALSE is read as True
question_paraphrase: cast_to_value only knows lowercase false/0 so FALSE falls to bool of a string which is True; Solibri fails the same file.
phrasing_notes: precise, cites spec test case, AI-assisted style report
answer_summary: Maintainer closed it as a spec hallucination by AI.

gloss_en: IDS entity requirement written as xs:restriction crashes ifctester on failure instead of reporting
title_original: AttributeError Restriction object has no attribute endswith
question_paraphrase: Applicability matches IfcColumn in an IFC2X3 model but the entity requirement enumerates IFCWALL; ifctester raises AttributeError instead of failing.
phrasing_notes: structured bug report with repro steps
answer_summary: Reproduced and a minimal fix PR opened.

gloss_en: First beginner project test crashes while drawing polyline walls
title_original: BonsaiBim first beginner project test
question_paraphrase: Auto-generated crash report after many polyline wall operations in a first test project.
phrasing_notes: title only describes situation, rest is pasted debug info
answer_summary: Not shown in the excerpt read.

gloss_en: Recorded general usability review by a beginner with annotated feedback, tracked to prevent beginner mistakes
title_original: General usability review from a beginner
question_paraphrase: A video of a first-time user struggling with the UI with annotated feedback was shared; track and improve UX.
answer_summary: Collected for UX improvements, many covered by other bugs.

gloss_en: Assigning an IfcWallType to a wall made from a cube mesh resizes and moves the mesh
title_original: Assigning wall type to mesh resizes the mesh
question_paraphrase: Make a cube, assign IfcElement and IfcWall, then assign any wall type and the mesh is resized; expected it to stay as placed.
phrasing_notes: numbered steps, offers a manual workaround in IFC text
answer_summary: Layered types override geometry; applying type rewrites the representation.

gloss_en: Spreadsheet import/export mishandles a dot in property set names
title_original: Spreadsheet Import/Export
question_paraphrase: A pset named MyPset.BIMData with property MyProperty is combined with dots so it cannot be parsed; suggests a slash separator.
answer_summary: Not a bug; text fields use selector and regex syntax, quote as /MyPset\.BIMData/.MyProperties or avoid special characters.

gloss_en: Mirroring a single wall throws an error because the mirror tool needs an axis object
title_original: Blender - Bonsai: Mirroring Wall
question_paraphrase: Mirroring a single wall causes an error with a long debug dump.
phrasing_notes: filed as bug, later admits misunderstanding the toolbar
answer_summary: Select exactly two IFC mesh objects; the active one is the mirror axis and must be a suitable object such as a beam.

gloss_en: Error when adding IfcSpace; maintainers advise beginners not to sync both blend and ifc files
title_original: error on adding spaces
question_paraphrase: Debug dump after adding Space0 to Ground_Floor fails.
phrasing_notes: no description, only auto debug text
answer_summary: Do not save both .blend and .ifc as parallel sources of truth when a beginner; open the IFC alone.

gloss_en: Drawings with the same title overwrite each other because file name is derived from title
title_original: Drawings with the same title overwrite each other when created
question_paraphrase: Several drawings are titled PROPOSED GROUND FLOOR (plan plus two isometrics); SVG filename comes from title so only the last is kept and appears 3 times on sheets. Want an ID or separate title.
answer_summary: Open; reporter notes wrong drawings stayed on sheets even after deleting and recreating.

gloss_en: Section drawing sometimes loses projection lines and objects on repeated runs without any change
title_original: Weird glitch where projection lines and objects go missing sometimes in drawings
question_paraphrase: Running EAST SECTION twice gives two different outputs with nothing changed; happens on other drawings too.
answer_summary: Open, intermittent.

gloss_en: Drawing camera objects stored in the IFC show as boxes in Solibri
title_original: IFC file from blenderbim with drawings shows up with boxes in solibri
question_paraphrase: Opening an IFC with drawings in Solibri shows the views as boxes; need a fix soon because I submit IFC files frequently.
answer_summary: Cameras use the body representation; maintainer asks whether a different context should be used.

gloss_en: Point cloud underlay rendered with default Blender shading style gives fully transparent images
title_original: Rendering the underlay with the default blender shading style produces completely transparent images
question_paraphrase: I used to render point clouds as drawing underlay but now images come out transparent with no error shown.
answer_summary: Non-IFC objects often have Disable in Renders on while visible in viewport; the underlay render honours hide_render.

gloss_en: Switching between drawings takes about 20 seconds; asks for speedups or multiple drawings open at once
title_original: Improve the speed of switching between drawings
question_paraphrase: A file takes around 20 s to switch from one drawing to another; is there a clever way or can several drawings be open at once?
answer_summary: A commit gives slight speedup on first activation only.

gloss_en: Shapely fill mode does not work when printing drawings that contain a linked project
title_original: Shapely Fill Mode not working when printing drawings with Linked Projects
question_paraphrase: Vector colour fill via .surface class is great but with a linked project the SVG has no .surface class.
answer_summary: Open.

gloss_en: Renaming a sheet or drawing moves files immediately but IFC only updates on save, leaving dangling file references
title_original: Bonsai: renaming a sheet or drawing without saving leaves the model pointing at files that no longer exist
question_paraphrase: Rename a sheet, close without saving IFC, reopen and Open Layout gives FileNotFoundError.
answer_summary: Follow-up reconciles layout with the model in both directions.

gloss_en: Filter query with != is rewritten wrongly after saving the filter or pasting it
title_original: Query malfunction searching with !=
question_paraphrase: query:Name!=/Test/ displays correctly but after saving or reloading Bonsai turns it into Name equals a string containing !=, giving the wrong set for drawings.
answer_summary: Import step put != inside the value while export looked elsewhere; fixed.

gloss_en: Wants a preference for default EPset_Drawing.Metadata so new drawings carry CSS classes without manual entry
title_original: Bonsai: add a preference for a new drawing's default Metadata
question_paraphrase: New drawings start with Metadata unset so stylesheet classes like Name-Wall and id-1220 have to be entered on every drawing; add Default Metadata under Preferences.
answer_summary: Open proposal.

gloss_en: Camera zoom and crop for drawings and BCF viewpoints reset after saving and reopening georeferenced models
title_original: Drawings & BCF from Georeferenced model
question_paraphrase: With large coordinates, setting zoom and print crop for a plan view is lost after save and reopen, camera falls back to viewport defaults.
answer_summary: Open.

gloss_en: Request for intelligent callouts on drawings
title_original: Support intelligent callouts on drawings
question_paraphrase: Would be nice to support intelligent callouts on drawings (screenshot of example).
answer_summary: Open.

gloss_en: Reflected ceiling plan drawing rebuilds its camera on every create and resets the drawing style to viewport
title_original: Reflected plan drawings rebuild their camera on every create_drawing
question_paraphrase: An RCP with a Default render type style renders as Viewport after each generation no matter how often I reactivate the style.
answer_summary: Open.

gloss_en: IfcTester web app cannot handle large models so users switch to Bonsai; WASM memory limit discussed
title_original: IfcOpenShell JS with Zig
question_paraphrase: Many users of the IfcTester app report it cannot handle large models; proposal to try a Zig build to go beyond WASM limits.
answer_summary: Explore Zig-based build as alternative.

gloss_en: Run clash between architecture and MEP files and list top offending pairs
prompt: run clash arc vs mep, allow touching off, tolerance 5mm. how many hard clashes, which element pairs are worst?
expected_behavior: Load both models, run clash with the given settings, report count, group by IFC class pair/storey and list top pairs with locations.

gloss_en: Clash positions look far from the model; check units
prompt: clash markers are way off in the middle of nowhere, project is in feet. can you check the units and the false origin and tell me where the clashes really are
expected_behavior: Read project length unit and map conversion/false origin, convert clash coordinates correctly, report real locations.

gloss_en: Check external walls have FireRating and IsExternal true
prompt: check this model vs our IDS: every IfcWall with IsExternal=TRUE needs FireRating in Pset_WallCommon. give me failed ones with names
expected_behavior: Run IDS validation, report failed walls with name/GlobalId/storey, note booleans in IDS are uppercase TRUE/FALSE.

gloss_en: Doors must have a wood material but test fails
prompt: my rule says IfcDoor must have material Holz but it fails even tho the doors have it. whats wrong? maybe material is on the type?
expected_behavior: Inspect door material association (type vs occurrence, layer/profile sets), explain IDS material facet semantics, suggest fix.

gloss_en: List drawings and sheets and find duplicate titles
prompt: list all drawings and which sheets they're on. any drawings with the same name?
expected_behavior: Enumerate IfcAnnotation drawings, their target view and sheet references; flag duplicate names that would overwrite SVG files.

gloss_en: Set drawing Metadata so CSS classes are generated on all drawings
prompt: set EPset_Drawing Metadata to 'Name, material.Category' on all my drawings so I can style hatches in css
expected_behavior: Edit EPset_Drawing.Metadata on every drawing annotation, confirm values, mention regenerate drawings.

gloss_en: Window not cutting the wall
prompt: added a window but wall has no hole. check the opening relation for that window and fix it
expected_behavior: Inspect IfcOpeningElement, IfcRelVoidsElement and IfcRelFillsElement for the window, repair missing relationships.

gloss_en: Total floor area per storey from spaces
prompt: gross floor area per storey from the IfcSpaces pls, and flag spaces w/o a Qto
expected_behavior: Sum Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities.NetFloorArea per storey, list spaces missing quantities.

gloss_en: Compare two revisions of the model
prompt: diff v3 and v4 of the arch model, what was added/deleted/changed, just walls and slabs
expected_behavior: Compare by GlobalId filtered to IfcWall/IfcSlab, report added, removed and changed attributes/psets.

gloss_en: Assign wall type without changing geometry
prompt: i drew walls as plain meshes, now i want to give them IfcWallType but keep the shape. possible without them jumping around?
expected_behavior: Explain that layered types override geometry; offer assigning type relation or material set while preserving representation, perform if possible.

gloss_en: Wall quantities net of openings
prompt: need wall net side area and volume by wall type. is gross=net in this file? openings should be subtracted
expected_behavior: Compute or read Qto_WallBaseQuantities, compare gross/net, verify openings subtracted, group by type.

gloss_en: Check georeferencing settings
prompt: is this model georeferenced? give me the eastings/northings, CRS and true north
expected_behavior: Read IfcMapConversion, IfcProjectedCRS and true north from the project context, report or state missing.

gloss_en: Find elements without classification
prompt: which elements dont have a classification ref? group by IFC class
expected_behavior: Query IfcRelAssociatesClassification, list unclassified elements grouped by class with counts.

gloss_en: Rename material categories for hatches
prompt: set material category = Concrete on all materials with 'conc' in the name so the hatch picks up
expected_behavior: Find IfcMaterial with matching names, set Category attribute, list changed materials.

gloss_en: First steps for a Revit user
prompt: im coming from revit, how do i make levels, walls and a section drawing in bonsai? whats the order
expected_behavior: Explain storeys, wall types, drawing creation and section camera in Bonsai with ordered steps; compare with Revit terms.

gloss_en: Bonsai does not activate after update
prompt: bonsai wont enable after updating blender, import error in console. what should i check first
expected_behavior: Ask for versions/OS, check Blender-Bonsai compatibility, conflicting add-ons, clean reinstall of extension.
